The level of purchasing power influences consumer spending.
Demand, in conjunction with inflation, can contribute to inflation acceleration.
Inflationary pressures can contribute to the acceleration of inflation.
The acceleration of inflation can influence the monthly PCE-price change.
The level of purchasing power influences consumer outlays on goods and services.
Consumer outlays on goods and services are a manifestation of consumer spending.
The monthly PCE-price change is the outcome variable.
